analysis: apex-centered amino-acid PWM and motif replication

esm2_frozen_bilstm_attn.background: same-protein exact-apex-Q8 anchors with no band in the exclusion window
esm2_frozen_bilstm_attn.control_weighting: controls sum to weight one within each matched band
esm2_frozen_bilstm_attn.kmer_definition: exact sequence present anywhere in the apex-centered window
esm2_frozen_bilstm_attn.kmer_inference: matched band-minus-mean-control effects averaged within protein; two-sided exact protein sign test; BH correction
esm2_frozen_bilstm_attn.replication_definition: same direction as train and held-out BH q at or below the replication threshold
esm2_frozen_bilstm_attn.reduced_motif_definition: exact class sequence present anywhere in the apex-centered window
esm2_frozen_bilstm_attn.reduced_motif_multiple_testing: BH correction is separate from exact amino-acid k-mers
